purpose: Prevent a canceled diagnostic download poll from saving or publishing a successful collection result after its own lifetime ends.

baseline.path: pollDiagnostic supplied the trust callback alone to receiveDiagnostic. The 15-second HTTP context constrained network I/O, but post-read and post-storage checks could not observe poll cancellation while the 1-minute collection request remained valid.
baseline.reproduction: FAIL in three deterministic cases: parent canceled at body EOF, parent canceled during storage, and storage finished at diagnosticPollTimeout plus one nanosecond. All published RECEIVED, peer.json and a receipt. Body-EOF cancellation also invoked storage once after cancellation. The deadline uses testing/synctest virtual time; no physical 15-second disk stall is claimed.

change.authority: Pass a combined poll-context-and-trust predicate to the existing receiveDiagnostic lifecycle checks. A cancellation observed after the body prevents storage; a cancellation observed after storage prevents receipt/path/state publication. Recheck the predicate before constructing the ACK too.
change.cost: Constant-time context.Err checks at the existing authorization checks plus one pre-ACK check. No new goroutines, body copies, digest passes, database calls or storage callbacks.
change.interfaces: No HTTP routes, JSON schemas, DB, installer, repository hygiene, runner or source-of-truth documents changed. Existing HTTP upload cancellation handling remains unchanged.

validation.regression: PASS: all three cancellations preserve PENDING without a path, receipt or ACK, and release receive admission. Body-EOF cancellation reduces storage callback calls from 1 to 0. Cancellation after storage does not pretend to undo the callback.
validation.recovery: PASS in each case: a live retry for the same request/transfer succeeds; its exact replay adds no second storage call. The two successful polls produce two ACKs and one new save.
validation.packages: PASS: go test -timeout 3m ./internal/peerupdate ./internal/residentagent, 17.583s and 8.392s, Go 1.27.3 windows/amd64 with repository runtime STW overlay.
validation.hygiene: PASS: changed Go files formatted with gofmt; git diff --check.
validation.skipped: Full repository, frontend, installer/release packaging and physical two-PC acceptance: only internal download-result lifetime validation changed; no program installation or public release was performed.

remainingRisk: A storage callback already in progress may still finish creating a file after cancellation. This patch rejects its late success publication; it does not preempt filesystem I/O or delete callback-owned output. Input-service recovery error 1066 and cursor handoff latency are outside this verification.
